# UIDragDetector

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIDragDetector")`

Makes its parent something a pointer drags (ADR 0128): a window by its title bar, a slider's thumb, a dial. A press on the parent or anything inside it that is then moved drags it, by mouse or by finger; a press that does not move is still a press.

`DragStyle` says how it moves and `ResponseStyle` what is written. The detector writes the parent's `Position` (or `Rotation`), so a parent inside a layout, which has no position of its own, is not moved.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BoundingUI` | `UIObject?` | — | read/write | An element the dragged one stays inside. Nothing is no bound. |
| `DragAxis` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.new(1, 0)` | read/write | The line a `TranslateLine` drag slides along, y down: `(1, 0)` is across, `(0, 1)` is down. |
| `DragRotation` | `number` | — | read-only | How far a `Rotate` drag has turned it from where it began, in degrees. |
| `DragStyle` | `Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle` | `Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle.TranslatePlane` | read/write | How the pointer's motion becomes the element's. |
| `DragUDim2` | `UDim2` | — | read-only | How far the drag has moved the element from where it began, as `ResponseStyle` measures it. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether a press starts a drag. |
| `MaxDragAngle` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The most it may turn it. |
| `MaxDragTranslation` | `UDim2` | `UDim2.new()` | read/write | The most it may be moved. |
| `MinDragAngle` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The least a `Rotate` drag may turn it, in degrees. Not applied while it equals `MaxDragAngle`. |
| `MinDragTranslation` | `UDim2` | `UDim2.new()` | read/write | The least the element may be moved from where the drag began. Not applied while it equals `MaxDragTranslation`, which is how a new detector has no limit. |
| `ResponseStyle` | `Enum.UIDragDetectorResponseStyle` | `Enum.UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.Offset` | read/write | What is written as it is dragged. |

## Events

Every signal here is **deferred** (ADR 0015): a handler runs at the next
drain point, never inside the call that fired it.

### `DragContinue(position: Vector2)`

The pointer moved while dragging.

### `DragEnd(position: Vector2)`

The press was released, or the element or the detector went away.

### `DragStart(position: Vector2)`

A press on the element began to move it. `position` is the pointer's, in pixels.
